$comment: Imports use explicit './x.ts' specifiers on purpose: Node 22.6+ strips TypeScript
types at runtime, so `node --experimental-strip-types src/cli.ts` runs this package
with no bundler and no build step -- which is the point of a local ingest tool.
Consequence: avoid TypeScript syntax that requires transformation (constructor
parameter properties, enums, namespaces). tsc still typechecks the same source.
